module

public import FormalConjecturesUtil

/-!
# Kummer–Vandiver conjecture

*Reference:* [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kummer%E2%80%93Vandiver_conjecture)
-/

@[expose] public section

open NumberField CyclotomicField IsCyclotomicExtension

namespace KummerVandiver

-- TODO(Paul-Lez): change `PNat` to `Nat` once the version of Mathlib we're on allows it.

/--
Kummer–Vandiver conjecture states that for every prime $p$, the class number of the maximal
real subfield of $\mathbb{Q}(\zeta_p)$ is not divisible by $p$.
--/
@[category research open, AMS 11]
theorem kummer_vandiver (p : ℕ+) (hp : p.Prime) :
    ¬ ↑p ∣ (classNumber (maximalRealSubfield (CyclotomicField p ℚ))) := by
  sorry

end KummerVandiver

reformulations.difference: The Lean statement quantifies over `p : ℕ+` with `PNat.Prime p`, not over prime natural numbers. The file's own TODO mentions this. It also includes p = 2, whereas some primary references (e.g. Ghate, Conjecture 1) state Vandiver's conjecture for odd primes only. For ℚ(ζ_p)⁺ it uses Mathlib's `maximalRealSubfield`, defined as {x | ∀ φ : K →+* ℂ, star (φ x) = φ x}, not the explicit field ℚ(ζ_p + ζ_p⁻¹).
reformulations.equivalence_argument: (1) Every prime is positive, and `PNat.Prime p` is by definition `Nat.Prime ↑p`. So `∀ p : ℕ+, p.Prime → ¬ ↑p ∣ h(p)` is equivalent to `∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → ¬ p ∣ h(p)`; I proved this `↔` in Lean. (2) The p = 2 case is true. `CyclotomicField 2 ℚ` has finrank φ(2) = 1 over ℚ, so its maximal real subfield is ⊤ ≅ ℚ, with class number 1, and 2 ∤ 1. I proved in Lean that `classNumber (maximalRealSubfield (CyclotomicField 2 ℚ)) = 1` and that the file's statement holds at p = 2. So including p = 2 matches Wikipedia's 'a prime p' and adds nothing beyond the odd-prime version. (3) For odd p, ℚ(ζ_p) is a CM field (Mathlib `IsCyclotomicExtension.Rat.isCMField`). By `CMExtension.eq_maximalRealSubfield`, the unique totally real subfield of index 2, ℚ(ζ_p + ζ_p⁻¹) = ℚ(ζ_p)⁺, equals Mathlib's `maximalRealSubfield`. Hence `classNumber (maximalRealSubfield (CyclotomicField p ℚ))` is exactly h_p⁺.

sources_consulted: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_unsolved_problems_in_mathematics (raw wikitext; entry for the Kummer–Vandiver conjecture)
E. Ghate, 'Vandiver's conjecture via K-theory', in Cyclotomic Fields and Related Topics (Pune, 2000), https://www.bprim.org/sites/default/files/vand.pdf (Conjecture 1)
review.notes:
The file has one declaration, `KummerVandiver.kummer_vandiver`. It elaborates to `∀ (p : ℕ+), p.Prime → ¬↑p ∣ classNumber ↥(maximalRealSubfield (CyclotomicField ↑p ℚ))`. I checked with pp.explicit that each name resolves to the root/NumberField declaration: `CyclotomicField`, `NumberField.maximalRealSubfield` and `NumberField.classNumber`. The `NumberField` instance on the subfield is `NumberField.of_subfield`. The class number is `Fintype.card` of the class group, so it does not depend on which instance is chosen. None of these are junk-value definitions: `CyclotomicField n K` is the splitting field of the n-th cyclotomic polynomial, and `classNumber` is always ≥ 1.

This matches the cited Wikipedia statement exactly: 'a prime p does not divide the class number h_K of the maximal real subfield K = ℚ(ζ_p)⁺ of the p-th cyclotomic field'. The docstring agrees too.

Status: Wikipedia's infobox has 'open problem = Yes', and the conjecture is listed among unsolved problems in number theory. It has been verified only for p < 2^31 (Hart–Harvey–Ong 2017). So `research open` is correct and there is no status issue.

In my scratch-file p = 2 check, elaboration picked the `DivisionRing.toRatAlgebra` instance over `CyclotomicField.algebra`, so `IsCyclotomicExtension {2} ℚ (CyclotomicField 2 ℚ)` would not synthesize until I pinned the algebra instance locally. This only concerns proofs, not the file's statement, which never needs that instance. The `PNat`→`Nat` TODO is maintenance only. The statement is already equivalent to the ℕ version, as proved above.
